jokes.text: Why didn't the stormtrooper become a baker? He kept missing the bowl.
Where do Jedi go to get their lightsabers fixed? The Crystal Clinic.
Why does Mace Windu have a purple lightsaber? Because he's one of a kind and he knows it.
Why is the Millennium Falcon always dirty? It has been through a lot of asteroids.
What do you call a Jedi chef? A Jedi Master-Chef.
How does Obi-Wan stay in shape? He does Jedi jumping jacks on the high ground.
Why did Padmé wear so many outfits? She was a queen of the wardrobe changes.
What did the Jedi student say to his teacher? "May the Force be with you on this test."
What did Padmé say to the slow elevator? "So this is how liberty dies, with thunderous waiting."
Why does Yoda talk backwards? Because his sentences go to the swamp first.
Why did C-3PO need a lawyer? He kept forgetting his droid rights.
Why do Jedi love the beach? So much high-ground sandcastle building.
Where does Princess Leia get her hair cut? At the Royal Bun Salon.
What do you call a really good lightsaber fight? A light show.
What's Grogu's favorite cereal? Frosted Frog Flakes.
What does Luke call his X-wing on a rainy day? A Wet-wing.
Why can't Darth Vader play hide and seek? Everyone can hear him breathing.
Why did BB-8 go to the bowling alley? He wanted to roll with his friends.
Why did Luke join the band? He was great on the light-saber-xophone.
Why did the clone get into trouble at school? He was copying his brother's homework. All of them.
What do you call a Death Star that tells jokes? A Pun Star.
What's an Ewok's favorite type of music? Drum and Endor bass.
Why do Jedi always pack an extra pair of socks? In case they get a hole in one.
What does Lando say to the fancy cape store? "Hello, what have we here?"
Why did Mace Windu get a job at a hotel? He's great at saying "This party's over."
What is Yoda's favorite type of pasta? Yoda-tini.
What do you call Chewbacca with chocolate stuck in his fur? A chocolate chip Wookiee.
What do you call Chewbacca when he sneezes? A Wookiee achoo.
What does a Jedi call a long nap? A Force Sleep.
Why did Yoda go to the pet store? To find a pet that was small, green and wise.
Why did the Jedi bring a broom to class? He heard it was time to sweep the Sith off their feet.
What do you call a Jawa who sells cars? A used-droid salesman.
Why did Luke take up farming? He was a moisture farmer before it was cool.
What's the Death Star's favorite exercise? Planet crunches.
What does Yoda say when he burps? "Excuse me, you must."
How do you stop an AT-AT? Tie its shoelaces together.
What do you call a Jedi in a snowstorm? Obi-Wan Kenobi-brrr.
What does Luke Skywalker drink? Blue milk. Or green milk if he's feeling adventurous.
What does a bantha eat for dessert? Bantha-split.
Why do Star Wars fans love bowling? Because the Empire Strikes Back.
Why did the Emperor bring a pencil to the battle? In case he needed to draw on the power of the dark side.
Why does Tatooine have such good sunsets? It has two of them.
Why did the mudhorn go to the spa? It wanted a mud bath.
What did one Death Star say to the other? "Nice to see you're fully operational."
Why does Grogu ride in a floating pram? Because walking is for grown-up Jedi.
What is a clone trooper's favorite game? Copycat.
What do Jedi say when they want a bigger pizza? "May the Forks be with you."
How does Darth Vader like his toast? On the dark side.
What did Yoda say to the student who didn't do homework? "Do or do not. There is no 'my dog ate it.'"
What is a Sith's favorite candy? Darth chocolate.
What's Kylo Ren's favorite dessert? Anything he can melt with a tantrum, like ice cream.
Why is Yoda such a good gardener? He has a green thumb. Two, actually, and a few fingers.
What did Chewbacca use to cool down? A Wookiee fan.
What does Han Solo order at the ice cream shop? A Kessel Run sundae in under twelve parsecs.
Why did Han Solo become a chef? He was great at making things in less than twelve parsecs.
What did Ahsoka say when she got a new haircut? Nothing. It's the same head-tails.
What is Darth Vader's favorite fruit? Dark-berries.
What did the droid say at Thanksgiving? "Please pass the gravy oil."
What did the mynock say to the Millennium Falcon? "Mmm, wiring."
What do you call a Star Wars movie about sheep? The Phantom Ewe.
What did the waiter say to the Jedi? "Your table is ready, Master."
What do you call Han Solo on a camping trip? A happy camper. He's used to the Hoth weather.
Why is Grogu so good at hide and seek? He fits in a soup bowl.
How does Yoda sign his letters? "Sincerely, Yoda you are reading."
Why did C-3PO cross the road? To tell everyone the odds of making it.
Why did the Jedi take his lightsaber to school? For show and tell.
What did Lando say to the cookie jar? "This deal is getting worse all the time."
How do clones pick a leader? They take a vote. It's always a tie.
Why did the Jedi bring string to the meeting? To keep everyone tied to the Force.
What did the protocol droid say to the waiter? "I'll have the oil of the day, please."
Why did BB-8 fail his driving test? He kept rolling through stop signs.
Why did the stormtrooper get a job at the bowling alley? Everything he throws ends up in the gutter.
What's a Jedi's favorite class? Force-ics.
What is the Emperor's favorite game? Simon Says. Well, Sidious Says.
Why are stormtroopers bad at hide and seek? They never hit their mark.
What is Darth Vader's favorite type of music? Heavy breathing metal.
Why does Han Solo always shoot first? He likes to get things done ahead of schedule.
Why did the young Jedi fail his driving test? He kept using the Force instead of the brakes.
Why do Jawas wear hoods? To keep the sand out of their snacks.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about cats? Attack of the Clawns.
What did the porg say to Chewbacca? "Please don't eat my friend."
Why did the Jedi take a nap? He was feeling Force-tired.
What do you call a Jedi who loves pancakes? Obi-Wan Ka-syrup-i.
How does Darth Vader get his kids to finish dinner? He uses the Force-feed.
What does Yoda call a sandwich? "Bread, meat, cheese, bread. Delicious, it is."
What did the space sandwich say? "May the forks be with you."
What do you call a Mandalorian who plays the violin? A Mandolin-orian.
What is Darth Vader's favorite kind of tree? A Sith-amore.
What's a stormtrooper's favorite game? Missed Connections.
Why did the Mandalorian never take off his helmet at dinner? He was saving his face for dessert.
What do Sith Lords put on their pancakes? Darth syrup.
What do you call a Sarlacc that just ate? A Sarlacc-full.
What did the X-wing say to the TIE fighter? "You've got a lot of nerve."
Why is Rey so good at scavenging? She can find something useful in any junk drawer.
What did Darth Vader say to the dentist? "The floss is strong with this one."
What's a Jedi's favorite type of math? Force-mulas.
What do you call R2-D2 when he's sad? R2-Blue.
What did the Rebel say to the Empire? "You haven't seen the last of us. Mostly because we're really good at hiding."
Why did Luke go to Dagobah? For the swamp spa treatment.
What did Rey say to the leftover pizza? "I've been waiting for someone to come back for me."
What do you call Grogu after a big meal? A full little womp rat.
What's a horse's favorite Star Wars character? Han Colo.
What do you call a lightsaber that tells jokes? Light-hearted.
What's the Mos Eisley Cantina's best seller? Blue milk shakes.
What do you call a group of porgs? A porg-ade.
What did the Jedi say at the bakery? "These are not the donuts you're looking for. Those are."
Why was Yoda always picked first for the team? Small he is, but strong with the Force, he is.
What did the Ewok say to the stormtrooper? "Watch out for that log!"
What do you call it when a Wookiee finishes a race first? A Chewbacca-win.
What did C-3PO say to R2-D2 on a long trip? "Are we there yet? The odds are not good."
What is Darth Vader's favorite holiday? Vader's Day.
What do Rebels eat at a picnic? Rebel-tine sandwiches.
What does a stormtrooper eat for breakfast? Imperial waffles.
Why did the stormtrooper bring a map to the Death Star? He kept getting lost in the hallways.
Why did the Rebels hide on Yavin 4? For the jungle view.
What is Grogu's favorite toy? The little silver knob from the Razor Crest.
Why did the stormtrooper fail archery class? He kept aiming for the stars.
Why did the Jedi give his lightsaber a name? Because it was one of a kind.
What did the TIE fighter wear to the wedding? A bow TIE.
What did C-3PO say when he got a new paint job? "I'm feeling golden."
What's a Jawa's favorite game? Hide and squeak.
How do Ewoks talk to each other? With Ewokie-talkies.
What do you call a Jedi who has just woken up? A Jedi Knight-cap.
What does C-3PO say when he's surprised? "Oh my! Goodness gracious!"
What did Admiral Ackbar say about the free cheese? "It's a mouse trap!"
What do you call R2-D2 in a snowstorm? R2-Brrrr-2.
What did Yoda say to the tired Padawan? "Nap, you must. Wake up, you will."
Why did Luke turn down the snack? He had a bad feeling about the expiration date.
What did the X-wing say to the runway? "I'll be landing in a few parsecs."
What is Obi-Wan's favorite greeting? "Hello there!"
Why did the lightsaber go to therapy? It had a lot of pent-up energy.
What do Gungans put on their toast? Jar Jar jam.
What did Obi-Wan say when he walked into the bakery? "Hello there! Your bread is the general Kenobi-scuit."
Which Star Wars character works at a restaurant? Darth Waiter.
Why are Jedi great at bowling? They always use the Force to pick up the spare.
Why is R2-D2 so good at dancing? He has all the right beeps.
What did one clone say to the other? "You look familiar."
What do you call a Jedi in a hurry? Obi-Wan Kenobi-zoom.
What do stormtroopers use to keep their armor clean? Storm-trooper wipes.
Why did the stormtrooper go to school? To get better aim.
What does Grand Moff Tarkin eat for breakfast? Tarkin bacon.
Why is Count Dooku so good at chess? He's had a lot of practice making counter moves.
Why did C-3PO go to school? To brush up on his protocol.
What did Obi-Wan say to the lost hiker? "These are not the trails you're looking for."
What do Jedi use to open PDF files? Adobe Wan Kenobi.
Why is General Grievous so good at juggling? He has four hands and a very bad cough.
What does Kylo Ren do when he loses at video games? He takes it out on the console.
How do Jedi win arguments? They use the Force of reason.
What did the Jedi say when he got the last cookie? "The Force is strong with this one."
What does Grogu do when he's bored? He uses the Force to steal snacks.
Why doesn't Han Solo enjoy his steak? It's Chewie.
What did the Rebel pilot say at the end of the trench run? "Woo-hoo! That was a one in a million shot."
What's BB-8's favorite sport? Bowling.
Why is Coruscant so busy? Everyone's in a hurry to get to the Senate.
What's a mynock's favorite snack? Power cables.
What did Yoda say when he saw a snail? "Fast, you are not. Admire your patience, I do."
What do you call a fish in Star Wars? Admiral Ackbar. Wait, he is one.
What is Wedge Antilles' favorite snack? Cheese wedges.
Why doesn't Darth Vader like math class? Too many problems with his Sith-agonometry.
What is the Empire's favorite kind of school? An Academy. Imperial, of course.
What is Poe Dameron's favorite breakfast? French toast. He loves anything that's flipped.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about tired Jedi? The Force Asleep.
Why did Chewbacca start a band? He's great at roaring the vocals.
What does Darth Vader put on his ice cream? Dark chocolate sprinkles.
What is a Jedi's favorite candy? Light-saber gummies.
Why did Chewbacca go to the barber? He was having a bad fur day.
How does Darth Vader drink his juice? Through a very long straw.
What do you call a Jedi who is really good at golf? A Force-some player.
Why is Poe the best pilot? He always knows how to take things for a spin.
What do pod racers eat? Pod-ato chips.
What do Ewoks drink? Ewok-ade.
What do Sith Lords put on their burgers? Darth mustard.
Why did the student bring a lightsaber to school? To cut down on homework.
What does Darth Vader say when he answers the phone? "Luke, I am your caller."
What is the Mandalorian's favorite type of music? Beskar-pella.
Why doesn't Jabba the Hutt go to the gym? He doesn't like to move.
What did the speeder bike say to the tree? "Watch out, here I come!"
What do you call a tauntaun who tells jokes? A taunt-fun.
Why did the astromech droid go to the music store? To pick up some new beeps.
Why did the Jedi Council meet on a Monday? Because the Force works hardest at the start of the week.
What is the best part about Naboo? The water's always fine.
Why don't lightsabers ever get lost? They always come with a hilt-in map.
Why did the Padawan get a gold star? He was a Force-ward thinker.
What do you call a rainy day on Kamino? Every day.
What do you call a cookie that turned to the dark side? A Darth Cookie.
What's a pirate's favorite Star Wars movie? The Empire Strikes Arrr.
What do you call a rancor that tells jokes? A ran-chuckle.
What does the Mandalorian say when he's lost? "This is the way. I think."
What did Anakin say to the sandcastle? "I don't like you."
Why don't Kaminoans go to the beach? Their whole planet is the beach.
What did Jabba say at the restaurant? "Bring me the slug sauce."
Why did Boba Fett get a new jetpack? The old one was getting a little Fett-igued.
What did the Star Wars fan get on his math test? An A for Anakin.
What did Han say to the slow cashier? "Hurry up, I've made the Kessel Run in less time."
What did the AT-AT say to the snowspeeder? "Hey, quit tying my shoelaces."
What did Leia say to the slow delivery droid? "You're my only hope, so hurry."
What do you call a sleepy Sith? Darth Napper.
Why does Snoke always sit down? He prefers a throne-sitting job.
What do you call a womp rat that tells jokes? A womp chuckle.
What is a Padawan's favorite subject? Force-ign languages.
Why do Sith have red lightsabers? Because the blue ones were sold out.
Why did R2-D2 go to the doctor? He had a bad case of the beeps.
What do you get when you cross a Wookiee with a cookie? A Wookiee cookie.
What do you call a Jedi who never stops talking? Obi-Wan Kenobi-blabber.
How do you know when a Wookiee is happy? He gives you a hug that lasts a few minutes.
What does Darth Vader say to his breakfast? "I find your lack of syrup disturbing."
What is BB-8's favorite dessert? A sphere of ice cream.
What did the Ewok say when he won the race? "Yub nub!"
What did the Mandalorian say to the Child? "This is the way. To bed."
What do you call a Wookiee who reads a lot? A Book-iee.
Why did the Rebel go to the dentist? To get a Rebel-ing tooth fixed.
What did Captain Rex say to the new clone? "Welcome to the team, brother. Now, which brother are you?"
What does a droid do at the beach? It catches some microwaves.
Why did the battle droid go to school? To learn more than two words.
Why did Darth Vader cross the road? To get to the dark side.
What is Darth Vader's least favorite chore? Dusting. He hates sand, and dust is sand's little cousin.
Why did Darth Maul take up yoga? He wanted to find his balance. Both halves.
What did Yoda say when he lost his keys? "Find them, I will. Look in the swamp, I must."
What's a Sith Lord's favorite subject in school? Hiss-tory.
Why do Sith Lords always come in twos? Because three would be a crowd, and two is the Rule.
What do Imperial officers eat for lunch? Galactic Empire-ial sandwiches.
What kind of pie does Darth Vader like best? Dark cherry pie.
What's Grogu's favorite sport? Frog-ger.
How does Yoda make his bed? "Make it, I will not. Use the Force, I will."
What's the best Star Wars snack? Darth Vader-tos.
What do you call a cat who uses the Force? A Jedi Purr-ster.
What do you call a rebel pilot who tells jokes? Wedge Antil-LOL.
What did Yoda say to the mirror? "Handsome, I am. Green, also."
Why does Yoda love math? "Count the numbers, I will. Fifty, forty, three."
What do you call a stormtrooper who plays tennis? A miss-ter.
What did Count Dooku name his pet bird? Count Coo-ku.
Why does Yoda use a cane? So he can save the lightsaber for special occasions.
Why did Darth Vader start a podcast? He loves the sound of his own breathing.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about horses? Attack of the Ponies.
What's a clone's favorite music? Anything with a lot of repeats.
What do you call it when Yoda plays golf? Yoda-ing a hole in one.
What does Yoda use to bake cakes? A Yoda-gurt frosting kit.
What is Princess Leia's favorite sport? Rebel-ball.
What did Obi-Wan say to the broken printer? "These are not the pages you're looking for."
How do Jedi pay for things? With Jedi Mind Tips.
What did Darth Vader say when the Wi-Fi went down? "I find your lack of bandwidth disturbing."
What do you call a stormtrooper who's really good at basketball? A rare sight.
What did the Jedi say when he finished his homework? "It is done."
What do you call someone who loves Star Wars? A Force-fan.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about sandwiches? Return of the Deli.
What does Ahsoka use to brush her teeth? Two toothbrushes, one in each hand.
Why is Grogu a great babysitter? He's 50 years old and still loves bedtime stories.
Why did Darth Vader go to the eye doctor? He wanted to see the light side for once.
What did General Grievous say when he caught a cold? "Cough, cough. You are a bold one."
How does R2-D2 get on a plane? He just rolls with it.
What do you call a Wookiee who likes to read? Chewbacca the bookie.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about the beach? A New Shore.
How does Chewbacca brush his fur? With a Wookiee comb.
How many stormtroopers does it take to change a lightbulb? Ten. One to change it, nine to miss the socket.
What did the sand say to Anakin? "Nothing personal, it's just my coarse nature."
What does Chewbacca say on his birthday? "Rrrrrraaaawwwrrrr!" Translation: "Thanks for the cake."
What did the Jedi Council say about the new chairs? "These are the seats you're looking for."
Why is the Millennium Falcon so fast? It made the Kessel Run in less than twelve parsecs.
How does Yoda get around the swamp? On his Yoda-bike.
Why do Jedi love hamburgers? They can always find the Force in the meat.
What did Leia say when she saw her new haircut? "Help me, Obi-Wan, you're my only hope."
Why is Princess Leia so good at sending messages? She has a lot of practice with holograms.
Why are Jedi good at telling time? They always feel a disturbance in the hour.
What does K-2SO say when he's happy? Nothing. He just tells you the odds.
What does Mace Windu use to make lemonade? A purple lightsaber and a lot of lemons.
What does Grogu use to tell the time? A Grogu-clock.
What do you call a droid that cooks? A chef-bot.
What did the Imperial officer say at the restaurant? "Table for one. And bring me a better admiral."
Where did Luke get his new hand? From the second-hand store.
Why did the tauntaun bring a sweater? It's Hoth, and it gets cold.
Why was the Death Star so good at parties? It was the life of the galaxy.
What is General Grievous's favorite exercise? Arm day. Four times.
What do scout troopers do on their day off? They take their speeder bikes to the drive-thru.
Why did Palpatine become a senator? He wanted to get to the bottom of the bills, one Order at a time.
What's the best way to get to Tatooine? Head toward the twin suns and don't stop until you're sandy.
How do Jedi do homework? With a lot of Force concentration.
Why did the clone go to the mirror store? He wanted to see his brothers.
What do you call a Jedi with a cold? Obi-Wan Kenobi-sniffles.
What does Boba Fett do on the weekend? He hunts for bargains.
What do you call a really long Star Wars movie marathon? An epic.
What is Lando's favorite drink? Anything served in a cloud cup.
What is the Rebel Alliance's favorite type of tree? A Rebel-wood.
What is Leia's favorite cereal? Cinnamon Buns.
What did the Sith say when he saw the sunset? "Finally, the dark side."
How do you fix the Death Star? With a little bit of Force-tape.
What does Han Solo say when someone thanks him? "I know."
How does Han Solo eat his breakfast? Fast. In less than twelve parsecs.
Why did R2-D2 go to the party? He heard there'd be a lot of beeps and bops.
What did Chewie say when he lost his comb? "Rrrrrraaaaawr." Which means "Has anyone seen my comb?"
What do you call a Jedi in the desert? Obi-Wan Kenobi-hot.
Why does Ahsoka hold her lightsabers backwards? She likes to keep people guessing.
What is a medical droid's favorite game? Operation.
How does Yoda keep his lunch fresh? In a Yoda-gurt cooler.
What do you call a rebel who loves basketball? A Rebel Dunk.
What do you call a droid that loves to fish? R2-Reel-2.
Why did Grogu go to school? To learn the Force and to eat everyone's lunch.
What's Jabba's favorite ice cream? Rocky Hutt.
Why did the Empire build the Death Star? Because they couldn't find a bigger moon.
What do you say to a Jedi who's about to go on a trip? "May the Force be with you. And your luggage."
What is Darth Maul's favorite dance? The double-bladed spin.
What do droids eat for breakfast? Bolts and nuts cereal.
What is Chewbacca's favorite food? Anything that's chewy.
What did Luke say when Yoda lifted his X-wing? "I don't believe it." What did Yoda say? "That is why you need a tow truck."
What's Anakin's favorite game at the beach? Sandcastle avoidance.
What does a Jedi drive? A Toy-Yoda.
What do you call a sheep in Star Wars? A Jedi Baa-ster.
Why did Grogu join the frog choir? He just wanted to eat the backup singers.
Why did the stormtrooper buy an iPhone? He couldn't find the Android he was looking for.
What does the Mandalorian say when he finds a good parking spot? "This is the way."
What do you call a Sith who works at a pet store? Darth Hamster.
What do you call a potato that has turned to the dark side? A Vader tot.
What did the stormtrooper say to the droid? "Move along. Move along."
What did Obi-Wan say at the barbecue? "Hello there. I'll have the high-ground beef."
Why are porgs so good at hide and seek? They blend in with the rocks. And the snacks.
Why did the stormtrooper join the choir? He was great at hitting the wrong notes.
What did Yoda say when he lost at video games? "Do or do not, there is no retry."
What do you call Darth Vader with a cold? Darth Sneezer.
What does a bounty hunter use to catch a bus? A tracking fob.
How do Jedi mail letters? With a Force Push.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about the mail? The Empire Ships Back.
What did Grogu say to the macaron? Nothing. He just took it.
How does BB-8 stay in shape? He does a lot of rolling exercises.
What does Count Dooku drink in the morning? A Sith-a-ccino.
What do you call a hut where Jabba lives? A Hutt hut.
What's Luke's favorite snack? Sky-walker crackers.
Why does Lando have so many capes? He doesn't want to miss a single breeze.
What do you call a droid that loves the garden? R2-Seed-2.
What did the Jedi say to the clumsy Padawan? "Watch your step. The Force can't catch everything."
What does Obi-Wan say before a big meal? "Use the forks, Luke."
Why don't Sith Lords play poker? Someone always senses the bluff.
What does a Jedi sleep in? A Jedi Knight-gown.
Why did the Sith apprentice go to school? To get a little more Sith-ucation.
Why was Han Solo carbonite-frozen? He was trying to stay cool.
What did Luke say when he couldn't find the TV remote? "Use the Force, Luke."
Why do Ewoks live in trees? The rent is cheaper.
What do you call a Sith on a bicycle? Darth Rider.
Why do Jedi make terrible comedians? Every joke is a Force-d laugh.
What do you call a stormtrooper at the beach? A sand-trooper.
Why did the AT-AT go to the gym? To work on its leg day. All four.
Why are lightsabers so popular at birthday parties? They light the candles and cut the cake.
What does Yoda wear to stay cool? Yoda-ga pants.
What's Coruscant's favorite holiday? City Lights Day.
What do Jedi put in their salads? Force-croutons.
What's a Wookiee's favorite cookie? Chewbacca chip.
What do you call a Jedi in denial? Obi-Wan Kenobi-lieve it.
What is Chewbacca's favorite dance? The Wookiee Boogie.
What do you call a Star Wars movie about golf? The Last Tee-dai.
What does a stormtrooper say when he finally hits the target? "Wait, really?"
What did Darth Vader say when he dropped his ice cream? "Nooooooo!"
Why does Anakin hate sand? It's coarse and rough and it gets everywhere. Especially in his shoes.
What do you call a Gungan who tells jokes? Jar Jar Grins.
What's the weather like on Hoth? Snow joke.
What did R2-D2 say to the toaster? "Beep boop." The toaster said, "Same to you."
What does R2-D2 like on his pizza? Beep-peroni.
Why did the Millennium Falcon go to the doctor? Its hyperdrive kept breaking down.
Why do droids make bad comedians? Their timing is too precise.
What do you call a Jedi pastry chef? Obi-Wan Cake-nobi.
What do you call an Imperial officer who loves the beach? A Storm-tanner.
Why does Darth Vader love car rides? The Imperial cruise control.
What do you call a pirate in Star Wars? Hondo. He's always looking for treasure.
What did the tauntaun say when he got cold? "I'm feeling a little un-hoth-y."
What did the Sarlacc say after lunch? "That was a Boba-lot."
What did the Force say to the Jedi? "I'm with you. Always."
What did Kylo Ren say to his messy room? "Let the past die. Clean it if you have to."
What do you call a droid that takes the long way around? R2-Detour.
What did the cantina band say after the show? "Thanks for listening. We'll be here all week. Every week."
What does the Force say when it's in a good mood? "I feel good about this."
How does Grogu ask for a snack? He just stares until you give him one.
Why did the Death Star always win at tug-of-war? It has a really strong tractor beam.
What do you call a Star Wars fan who loves the beach? A sand person.
What does Emperor Palpatine eat for dessert? Unlimited powder sugar.
Why does Grogu always get the cookies? He has the Force, and nobody can say no to that face.
Why do droids never get tired? They're always fully charged.
Why did the Rebels go to the gym? To build up their Alliance.
What is Yoda's favorite dessert? Yoda-dle-doo cake.
What is a Jedi's favorite dance move? The Jedi Shuffle.
How did the droid feel after the battle? A little rusty.
Why does Jar Jar make a great lifeguard? He's always ready to go "yousa in the water."
What's a stormtrooper's favorite drink? Clone-ade.
Why did the Jawa start a recycling business? He knew how to turn junk into treasure.
What is a droid's favorite music? Heavy metal.
What did the Millennium Falcon say to the X-wing? "You're fast, but I've got the parsecs."
Why are snowtroopers so cool? They're always chill.
What's a Jedi's favorite song? "May the Fourth Be With You."
What did the Star Destroyer say to the little ship? "You're looking a bit small."
What do you call a Star Wars movie about cooking? The Empire Bakes Back.
What did Yoda say when he saw himself on a 4K TV? "HDMI."
How does Yoda fix his cold? "Cough drops, I need. Hmm."
